importGuide.genshin.showcase.title: Character Showcase (UID)
importGuide.genshin.showcase.summary: Reads the characters you show on your public in-game profile.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro1: Nothing to install, takes a minute
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro2: Includes your in-game total stats (ER, CRIT, EM...)
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro3: Repeat it with other characters to build up your roster
importGuide.genshin.showcase.con2: No unequipped artifacts, so no "better piece you own" suggestions

importGuide.genshin.file.summary: Our scanner for Windows reads every character, weapon and artifact from the game and saves them as a GOOD file, which you upload here. A GOOD file from any other tool works too.
importGuide.genshin.file.pro1: All characters, weapons and artifacts at once
importGuide.genshin.file.pro2: Finds better artifacts you already own
importGuide.genshin.file.pro3: Talent levels and exact roll counts

importGuide.genshin.showcase.intro: Only what your public profile shows can be read, so first put the characters you want analyzed into your Character Showcase.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step1.title: Open your profile
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step1.body: In the game press Esc to open the Paimon menu, click your avatar at the top left and choose "Edit Profile".
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.title: Fill the Character Showcase
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.body: Open "Character Showcase" and pick up to 12 characters. Their weapons and artifacts are shown as they are equipped right now.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.tip: Start with the characters you want to improve; you can swap them later and import again.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step3.title: Turn on "Show Character Details"
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step3.body: Still in the profile settings, enable "Show Character Details". Without it only names and levels are public.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step4.title: Let the profile refresh
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step4.body: The public profile updates when you log out or after a few minutes. Entering and leaving your Serenitea Pot also refreshes it.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step5.title: Find your UID
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step5.body: Your UID is the 9 or 10 digit number in the bottom-right corner of the game screen and on your profile.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble1: "Show Character Details is turned off": enable it in Edit Profile and wait a few minutes.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble2: Old data: a public profile is cached for a few minutes; import again a bit later.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble3: Characters from an earlier import stay in the app, so you can rotate your showcase and import several times.
importGuide.genshin.file.intro: The easiest way to the file is our scanner for Windows. It reads your characters, weapons and artifacts from the game's screen, as you see them - it never touches the game's files or memory, and sends nothing about you anywhere - and saves them as a GOOD file, the common format of Genshin Impact inventories. A GOOD file from any other tool works as well.
importGuide.genshin.file.fileHint: A .json file in the GOOD format
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.title: Start the scanner
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.body: Open PowerShell as administrator: right-click the Start button and choose Terminal (Admin) or Windows PowerShell (Admin). Paste this line there and press Enter. It downloads the scanner (about 60 MB), checks its fingerprint and starts it; when you are done, it is deleted again.
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.tip: The game runs as administrator, so the scanner must as well: without it, Windows blocks the scanner's clicks and key presses.
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.command: The line to paste into PowerShell
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.link: How the scanner works, and its source code
importGuide.genshin.file.step2.title: Get the game ready
importGuide.genshin.file.step2.body: Run the game in English, full screen, at a 16:9 resolution (1920×1080, 2560×1440 or 3840×2160). The scanner asks for the names your Traveler, Wanderer, Manekin and Manekina have in the game: type them exactly as the game shows them.
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.title: Scan the inventory and the characters
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.body: Open the inventory (B) on the Weapons or the Artifacts tab, scrolled to the top, or the character screen (C), and press Ctrl+S. Keep off the mouse and keyboard until the scanner beeps; Ctrl+S again stops it. Scan the weapons, the artifacts and the characters, in any order.
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.tip: 1800 artifacts take about 15 minutes, the characters a couple of minutes. What the game's filters hide in the inventory is not scanned.
importGuide.genshin.file.step4.title: Import the GOOD file
importGuide.genshin.file.step4.body: When everything is scanned, the scanner saves the file in your Downloads folder and copies it to the clipboard. Upload it or paste it in the next step; then press Enter in the scanner, and it deletes the file and everything it saved.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble1: The scanner says it is not running as administrator: close PowerShell, open it again as administrator and paste the line once more.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble2: A scan stopped: the scanner says why and what to do - another tab open, the list not at the top, the game not in English. Put it right and press Ctrl+S again.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble3: Another tool than ours is used at your own risk. Our scanner only looks at the screen and presses keys as you would, and this site never asks for your game password.
